bug_title: Step 3 manual slicing workflow not using Step 2 detected loops

root_cause.summary: generateSlicePoints() always used beat-grid granularity slicing, ignoring sliceModeAuto_ flag and detected loops from Step 2
details: In Step 2, loops are detected and stored in detectedLoops_ (visual) and currentBeatGrid_.detectedLoops (for processing)
When transitioning to Step 3 (Sample Slice), generateSlicePoints() is called
The function ALWAYS generated slices based on beat interval granularity (1 bar, 1/2 bar, 1 beat, etc.)
Even when sliceModeAuto_ was true (AUTO mode), it never checked this flag
AUTO mode was supposed to use detected loops as slice points, but this logic was missing

fix_applied.description: Added AUTO mode handling to generateSlicePoints() that uses detectedLoops_ as slice points

changes.description: Added AUTO mode branch at start of generateSlicePoints() that uses loop boundaries from detectedLoops_ as slice points
Updated AUTO button onClick handler to call generateSlicePoints() instead of just clearing slicePoints_

step_2.action: User sets BPM and clicks 'Detect Loops'

step_3_auto_mode_before_fix.behavior: BROKEN - always used beat-grid granularity, ignoring detected loops

step_3_auto_mode_after_fix.behavior: FIXED - uses detectedLoops_ boundaries as slice points in AUTO mode

expected_behavior: In Step 2, detect loops from BPM and downbeat settings
In Step 3 with AUTO mode, slice points should appear at loop boundaries
In Step 3 with MANUAL mode, slice points use beat-grid granularity as before
